name: live-photo
description: Turn any video into an iPhone Live Photo (paired HEIC + MOV) on a Mac that iOS accepts as a moving lock screen wallpaper. Uses ffmpeg plus macOS AVFoundation / VideoToolbox / ImageIO via a Swift script (60 fps HEVC with frame interpolation and the Live Photo metadata tracks iOS checks). Can also create the source from a subject by chaining nanobanana (still image) and gemini-omni (image-to-video).
